paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
2. 
The shares of ACB Ltd. are presently traded at ` 51 and the company is 
expected to pay dividends of ` 5 per share with a growth rate expected 
at 10% per annum. It plans to raise fresh equity share capital. The 
merchant banker has suggested that an underpricing of ` 2 is necessary 
in pricing the new issue besides involving a cost of ` 50 paise per share 
on miscellaneous expenses. The cost of new equity shares (assuming no 
change in dividend rate and growth rate) will be:  
(A)  18%  
(B)  
17.5%  
(C)  18.25%  
(D)  20.31% 
Financing Decision – Leverages
